plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF risk. Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add QQQI to 25% for income and stability. Buy NET at 5% as a top-quality scanner setup.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, but still carries market risk from broad index exposure.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Buy KTOS at 4% and NET at 4% to add quality tech from scanner setups.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It maintains some market exposure and quality tech, with reduced but still present leverage, leading to moderate drawdowns.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Add SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to increase leveraged ETF exposure. Buy KTOS at 6% and NET at 6% to concentrate in high-scoring scanner setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. This approach significantly increases both potential upside and drawdown, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing, meaning substantial losses can occur quickly.
